about_the_game:
🚀 Blast through the bullet storm and rule the galaxy!
A cat-headed cosmic warrior fights with their final nine lives in a roguelike bullet hell.
Dodge, shoot, and unlock powerful skills — every second counts!



🎮 Galactic Nine Lives throws you into a neon-soaked battlefield of bullets, bosses, and bizarre planets. You’re not just any hero — you’re a half-human, half-cat cosmic warrior armed with reflexes, rage, and raw firepower.

🐱 Left Click: Rapid-fire green shots
🧡 Right Click: Bouncing orange chaos
🔥 Unlock red, blue, and purple fireballs — each with unique effects
🎯 Survive 20-wave gauntlets with elite enemies and flying bosses
🧠 Choose from 40+ upgrade skills with strategic depth
💀 One run, one chance…!



Inspired by retro bullet hells and modern roguelikes, Galactic Nine Lives is pure arcade mayhem in a minimalist 2-bit pixel art world. Perfect for short bursts of action — or endless score-chasing marathons.

💾 Upgrades
🕹 keyboard/mouse & Controller support
🖤 A sleek, stylish aesthetic built for pixel lovers

How far can you make it before your nine lives run out?

Minimum:
